name: musket-ammo-items
description: The musket ammunition chain in the game is the approved one (D-080 / D-081): Paper (Workbench, 2 Resin + 1 Leather Scraps), Iron Bullet (Forge level 2, 1 Iron makes 5) and Paper Cartridge (Workbench level 2, 1 Gunpowder + 1 Iron Bullet + 1 Paper); all three stack to 50, are Material items with the mod's own prefab, and are listed in KydlCore's KY-Items registry.

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: piece_workbench level 1, makes 1, enabled True: Resin x2, LeatherScraps x1
steps.label: the paper recipe in the game

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: forge level 2, makes 5, enabled True: Iron x1
steps.label: 1 iron makes 5 bullets at forge level 2

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: piece_workbench level 2, makes 1, enabled True: GP_Gunpowder x1, GP_IronBullet x1, GP_Paper x1
steps.label: the cartridge needs gunpowder, a bullet and paper
five cartridges can be carried (the model prefab loads)

steps.label: every item and piece of the mod is in the KY-Items list
